blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Quezon City government has advised motorists to expect heavy traffic in some areas on Sunday due to the procession of the image of La Naval de Manila. In an advisory, the city government said the “Recorrido,” or route of the La Naval de Manila image procession, will run from Sto. Domingo Church to the Diocesan Shrine of Sto. Niño Parish. READ: Over 200,000 join La Naval annual procession – QCPD “Motorists are advised to take alternative routes,” it added.
